purpose: Country-wise indirect-tax baseline configuration for a Laravel application
important: This is a baseline tax configuration, not legal or tax advice.
A country-level default rate must not override product/service-specific, destination-based, registration, threshold, exemption, reduced-rate, or tax-nexus rules.
For the United States, Canada, Brazil, India, Malaysia, Pakistan, China, and other jurisdictional systems, use jurisdiction-specific rule tables before final calculation.
Keep rates effective-dated so historical invoices can be recalculated using the rules that were active at the transaction date.

source.primary: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries VAT rates quick chart

IN.calculation_notes: Intra-state supplies generally use CGST + SGST/UTGST; inter-state supplies generally use IGST. Product/service classification can change the rate.

US.calculation_notes: Rates and taxability are jurisdiction-, product-, customer-, sourcing-, and nexus-dependent. Do not use one national rate.
US.rate_source: Avalara / state and local tax authorities
